description: This file defines an interface for representing promises in asynchronous programming within the GuzzleHttp Promise library. It specifies methods for chaining, resolving, rejecting, canceling, and waiting on promises.

classes.name: PromiseInterface
classes.description: Defines the contract for promise objects representing asynchronous operation results.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Registers fulfillment and rejection callbacks, returns a new promise.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Registers a rejection callback, returns a new promise.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the promise with a given value.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the promise with a given reason.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Attempts to cancel the promise execution.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for promise completion and unwraps the result or throws if rejected.
